verdicts.one_liner: Card Trick gutted and Plated Armor counters Full Auto; pivot to the gun build or fall behind.
verdicts.direct: Card Trick heal 75->60 and spirit scaling 0.75->0.5 plus resist-shred -8%->-7% cut her sustain and debuff; Full Auto spirit 0.03->0.045 is only a small compensation.
verdicts.indirect: Plated Armor now eats Full Auto's on-hit spirit damage — a direct counter — while Slowing Hex CD 27->29s trims CC uptime and the removed comeback bounty strips her late-scaler safety net.
build_adjustments: Stop maxing Card Trick; move those points into Full Auto.
Keep the gun build (Capacitor, Lucky Shot); the CC build lost its heal and shred.
Expect Plated Armor on tanks — don't build around Full Auto's on-hit spirit vs them.

verdicts.one_liner: Four-item pile-on kills the proc carry; only the silence-cage utility build survives.
verdicts.direct: Bullet damage/boon 0.28->0.25, fire-rate spirit scaling 0.25->0.21, Alchemical Flask range/speed -30%, Willpower T3 and debuff resist all cut — a major kit nerf.
verdicts.indirect: Mercurial Magnum 0.49->0.38, Spiritual Overflow's triple nerf, Veil Walker losing Sprint Boots, and Plated Armor blocking Mercurial on-hit together delete his proc-carry build from every side.
build_adjustments: Drop Mercurial Magnum and Spiritual Overflow; the on-hit carry core is gone.
If you stay, run the silence-cage utility build with Fortitude/survivability, not damage.
